notes: Maintenance, Consequences & Home Polish: equipment, structures, batteries, and citizen chassis now accumulate real wear with condition-based capability loss, service/repair/replacement jobs, and stable maintenance-event history. Memory retains only meaningful validated maintenance experiences, while passive wear does not flood context. Citizen-to-citizen talk is more reliable because durable raw exchanges are saved before best-effort claim/provenance enrichment, with bounded retry and diagnostics but no fabricated fallback dialogue. Home now has full-height scrollable citizen and Visit rails, citizen search/filter groundwork, compact Recent Activity, bounded maintenance alerts, and a lightweight 2D avatar framework with validated-state animation. Citizens and Records show authoritative maintenance condition/effective capability.
